ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels (~95%) with sparse, high-intensity white pixel clusters (~5%)
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigment across the entire visible surface; sparse, non-contiguous white focal spots and thin linear marks distributed irregularly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 55 degrees with deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serration; primary peaks located on the outer thirds of both lobes; secondary micro-serrations visible along the interior edge toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge with a tapered, upward-curving sweep leading to sharpened lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white circular clusters observed on the interior section of the right lobe and scattered near the leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense calcified barnacle clusters present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; visible protrusion from the fluke's geometric boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish, irregular pixel mass (likely organic debris/kelp) entangled on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip.
